title: Slice restriction preserves K-injectives at independent ring universes
statement: For C,J,R,U and m=max(u,v,r), with abelian sheafification on the ambient and slice sites, module restriction overFunctor.{m} R U sends every K-injective cochain complex to a K-injective complex. No cover or subterminality is required.

source.place: lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open, via the exact-left-adjoint acyclic-Hom argument.

proof.text: Use the exact direct-sum extension and its adjunction with restriction.
Apply preservation of K-injectives by the right adjoint of an exact additive functor: termwise adjunction transports maps from acyclic complexes and their null-homotopies.

theorem overFunctor_preservesKInjectiveComplexes_ofUniverses
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) (U : C)
    [HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    [(J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] :
    (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U).PreservesKInjectiveComplexes
